candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Interactive Trait Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Rebuild the adoption certificate step into a split-screen design where users choose interactive pet traits while previewing their custom adoption certificate live.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a 71.1% conversion rate and median time of 89s; adding an interactive layout reduces drop-off and clarifies customization.

adoption_certificate.headline: Personalize & Sign Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Choose your companion's core personality traits before finalizing adoption.

guard.reason: The redesigned certificate component replaces the official stamp required by the adoption certificate step.

candidates.title: Desktop Control Orientation Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated new screen 'new_desktop_controls_guide' right before completing onboarding to visually explain hotkeys and system tray controls.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, while finish step conversion drops to 73.8%.

new_desktop_controls_guide.headline: Mastering Desktop Companion Controls
new_desktop_controls_guide.body: Learn quick mouse gestures and keyboard shortcuts to interact with or dock your new pet.

components.text: Right-click pet for instant menu; Press Ctrl+Shift+P to summon or hide.

guard.reason: Adding a new onboarding screen after home_intro is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Finish step drops 26.2% and support notes post-onboarding confusion, but introducing a full new screen adds cost.

candidates.title: Multi-Pet Selection Sound & Animation Preview Flow
candidates.change: Add audio and animated action previews to pick_friend screen so users test companion reactions prior to final choice.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops 28.9% and support receives complaints regarding unexpected pet visuals or behaviors.

guard.reason: The pick_friend screen loses its core job of allowing the user to select/choose a pet.

candidates.title: Defer Account Creation to Final Companion Handoff
candidates.change: Move the sign_in screen to occur after the waiting step immediately before home_intro so users experience setup first.
candidates.why: Early sign-in causes friction, while 8 support tickets mention pets missing/reset after signing in with wrong accounts early on.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in to occur after adoption and waiting is explicitly allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support tickets regarding account reset friction during early sign-in.

candidates.title: Persistent Account Warning Microcopy on Sign In
candidates.change: Display a prominent hint on the sign_in screen clarifying that signing in saves your pet permanently to prevent account resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails explicitly report pets missing or reset after signing in again with duplicate or wrong accounts.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your main email to ensure your companion state and memory are safely saved to the cloud.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Live Generation Activity Log on Waiting Screen
candidates.change: Add a real-time activity log component to the waiting screen showing asset rendering and behavior initialization progress.
candidates.why: Home step (waiting) has a mean time of 2336s (38+ minutes), leading to drop-offs when users assume the app has hung.

components.text: Synthesizing pet behaviors and desktop overlay shaders

guard.reason: Adding rendering progress details to the waiting screen is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Massive disparity between median (201s) and mean (2336s) home waiting times suggests users abandon during asset generation.

candidates.title: Desktop Overlay Launch Reassurance Copy
candidates.change: Update home_intro headline and body to reassure users that the pet will render over all desktop apps safely without stealing window focus.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported issues with pets not displaying or opening on desktop, and finish step drops 26.2%.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready to Roam Your Screen!
home_intro.body: Your pet will gently sit on your taskbar and stay on top of active windows. You can move or minimize it anytime.

guard.reason: Updating text copy on home_intro within onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak targeting the finish step drop-off (26.2%) and reported desktop overlay concerns.

candidates.title: Asset Preparation Completion Desktop Alert Prompt
candidates.change: Enable background notification switch and opt-in message during the waiting step so users get alerted when generation finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting time mean is extremely long (2336s), causing users to switch away and forget the desktop app.

waiting.body: Generation is running in the background. We will send a system notification as soon as your companion is ready.

guard.reason: Configuring notifications and waiting screen information is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Helps recover users who switch away during the extreme 38+ minute average wait time.

candidates.title: Companion Accessory Unlocks Incentive Badge
candidates.change: Add an exclusive onboarding pet accessory badge highlight to choose_path screen encouraging path completion.
candidates.why: Initial onboarding funnel loses ~14% at path selection; upfront reward incentives drive progression.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy cannot mention free extras or bonus gifts such as a starter accessory pack.

candidates.title: Story Screen Centered Visual Highlights Layout
candidates.change: Re-layout the story screen to centered with visual mascot animation and step countdown counter to set quick expectations.
candidates.why: Mean time on initial screens is high (514s), requiring a cleaner, faster intro layout.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout and visual components inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: First step loses 13.8% and has high mean time, but layout redesign requires a full release.
